# God Wand 1.5.0

> God Wand is a premier Minecraft magic mod featuring eight catastrophic and cinematic spells with customizable terrain manipulation, boss damage routing, custom 3D wand models, and extensive server/client configuration. Available across 10 builds (Fabric & NeoForge for 1.21.1, 1.20.1 Forge/Fabric, 1.21.11, 26.1.2, and 26.3).

## Documentation Files
- [Full LLM Knowledge Base](llms-full.txt): Comprehensive technical documentation, spell metrics, server & client configs, commands, and presets.
- [Official Web Wiki](https://god-wand-wiki.vercel.app/): Interactive trilingual web documentation with dark/light mode and search.
- [CurseForge Page](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/god-wand): Download installable jars and release notes.
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/HyIsNoob/god-wand): Source code and issue tracking.

## Core Capabilities & Spells
- **1. Spatial Path:** Toggleable spatial tunnel through mountains with automatic block restoration, projectile shielding, and sneak-bridge generation.
- **2. Singularity:** 3-tier charged gravity orb pulling entities and terrain, with manual early collapse and auto-healing block restoration.
- **3. Earth Drill:** 4-tier charged spinning rock drill slammed into earth; automatically equips Aqua Heartia wand skin.
- **4. Supernova:** 7-second charged black hole executing mobs <= 50 HP and carving a 120-block crater; merges XP orbs for tick performance.
- **5. Stone Cannon:** 4-tier high-velocity piercing compressed stone projectile with impact explosion; automatically equips Aqua Heartia.
- **6. I am Atomic:** 19-second charged sword stance with complete invulnerability, release-to-detonate 9,999 center damage, fluid clearing, and 98-block circular crater; automatically equips Shadow Blade.
- **7. Fuga:** Blazing arrow transforming into a soaring phoenix, falling meteor, and 384-block pillar of fire (9,999 DMG); slows enemies under meteor and shockwaves track terrain contours.
- **8. Silent Gate:** Summons a celestial winged gate from a giant sky circle; command the gate to rain light beams (80 DMG each) on monsters with a final 6x golden kill beam (480 DMG); automatically equips Silent Witch Staff.

## Key Controls
- Hold `V`: Radial skill wheel (8 skills).
- `Right-Click`: Cast / charge / command.
- `K`: Client visual settings & wand model picker.
- `Shift` while active: Build bridge (Spatial Path) / Sneak to cancel (Silent Gate).
- `Esc` or `F5`: Skip cinematic cutscenes (Atomic, Fuga, Silent Gate).
- `/godwand lock <skill>` & `/godwand unlock`: Admin single-skill lock (OP Level 2).
- `/godwand reset_cooldowns [players]`: Reset all skill cooldowns (OP Level 4).
